description: 1 master suite (en-suite bathroom), 1 single bedroom, 1 shared full bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on two facades. En-suite bathroom (4.5sqm) directly accessible from master bedroom. Kitchen in lower section of open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Cook faces wall. Living arrangement: large L-shaped open plan, kitchen at one end, dining table center, seating extending into right wing. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. TV visible in living area. Bathroom config: 1 en-suite bathroom accessible from master bedroom only; 1 shared full bathroom from corridor. Single bedroom has desk visible in plan. Large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room adjacent to kitchen zone, usable as kitchen pantry, laundry or general storage. Entry from top. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples with occasional guest, people working from home in single bedroom.
not_suitable_for: families requiring two children's bedrooms and a home office simultaneously
